did.unittitle: World Arts and Culture. Administrative files.
did.abstract: Record Series 731 contains the administrative files of UCLA's World Arts and Cultures Department. Files include administrative, event documentation, and recordings of events.

accessrestrict.head: Access
accessrestrict.p: COLLECTION STORED OFF-SITE AT SRLF: Open for research. Advance notice required for access. Contact the UCLA Library Special Collections Reference Desk for paging information.

userestrict.head: Publication Rights
userestrict.p: Copyright of portions of this collection has been assigned to The Regents of the University of California. The UCLA University Archives can grant permission to publish for materials to which it holds the copyright. All requests for permission to publish or quote must be submitted in writing to the UCLA University Archivist.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: [Identification of item], World Arts and Culture. Administrative files (University Archives Record Series 731). UCLA Library Special Collections, University Archives.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Record Series 731 contains the administrative files of UCLA's World Arts and Cultures Department. Files include administrative materials such as correspondence, contracts, reports, and advertising information; and event documentation including programs, flyers, press releases, pamphlets, photos, and scrapbooks. This collection also contains recordings of events such as rehearsals and performances of freshman, senior, and professional music and dance concerts, available on audio cassettes, 1/4" reel to reel audio tapes, 3/4" video cassettes, HI8 video cassettes, and digital video cassettes, and other unspecified video media. Additionally, this collection contains slides and sheet music.
This is an active record series; additional University records are expected to be added.
